doc.description: Iridium Link Controller: call the air modem and bridge the call data to the Paparazzi UDP link.
doc.usage: usage: iridium_link.py [-h] [-d DEVICE] [-b BAUD] [-n NUMBER] [--pin1 PIN1] [--pin2 PIN2] [--udp_in UDP_IN] [--udp_out UDP_OUT]

option.description: serial device of the ground modem (default /dev/ttyUSB0)
phone number of the air modem (default 00881234567890)
UDP port receiving data for the aircraft (default 4243)
UDP port the aircraft data is broadcast to (default 4242)
